key_capabilities.note: The four ready experiences are 'VR Collaboration — Fire Fight Training', 'Fire Extinguisher VR Training', 'Fire Scene Inspection' and 'Emergency Fire Drill'. SimLab also offers to build customers' models from photos, drawings or pre-plans. Home lists plugins for 18 applications (for example SolidWorks, Blender, Revit, Maya). Home says version '16' is 'Available Now!' for Composer and VR Studio; the 404 product pages were for version 15. No assessment, scoring or learner analytics features are described on the pages read.
